reviews.author: Private Eye
reviews.text: Camped here for 5 days and had a magical experience! Very clean campground with super friendly staff. Wood sold every evening 4-6p. Bathrooms are clean with hot showers! Lots of critters to keep you company (the good kind) but there are some trash pandas. Would visit again AND recommend.

reviews.author: Kevin V
reviews.text:
Took my family to Sunset Bay Campground for their first taste of the Oregon coast.
They loved it!
Used it as a base camp while we visited other places each day.
Loop A is under renovation from storm damage.
The beach and surrounding areas have changed since I was there in the '80s. Very enjoyable and relaxing.
Images are not on a particular order.
Beach and Bay, local creatures, cliff vid and images are from the trail that wanders south up the mountain from Sunset Bay. Be careful on the cliff edges, stay back. Soft ground.

reviews.author: Julie Jones
reviews.text: Souch fun to introduce my granddaughters to tide pools at the same beach I learned about them. Unfortunately the park fees are steep ($12 for out of state) and the QR code wasn't working. If we hadn't been with another person that was waiting in their vehicle, we would have received a ticket

reviews.author: Matt Vickery
reviews.text: I stopped here on a road trip on a recommendation from some friends that were local to the area. I got to see the sunset at the bay, and then got a campsite across the street. The sea lions sang me to sleep, and I had a beautiful hike the next morning. 10/10 would recommend stopping and at least checking out the surrounding area.

reviews.author: Dan Brennen
reviews.text: What an incredibly beautiful place to have here. The dunes were just amazing and peaceful and I felt like I was the only one there. What a treat!
